starter.label: Starter
starter.description_vi: Nhận diện đúng/sai rõ ràng. Câu ngắn, 1 lớp ngữ pháp, distractor rõ.

build_up.label: Build Up
build_up.description_vi: Áp dụng trong ngữ cảnh dài hơn. Lỗi tinh tế hơn, options gần nhau hơn.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.description_vi: 2–3 lớp ngữ pháp đồng thời. Distractor gần đúng, sai ở chi tiết nhỏ.
challenge.distractor_strategy: near_correct — sai ở chi tiết nhỏ

starter.stem: If I had known about the disaster, I ___ have helped.
starter.explanation_short: Type 3: If + had V3, would + have + V3.
starter.explanation_long: Conditional Type 3: If + Past Perfect, would + have + V3. Tiếc nuối quá khứ.
starter.feedback_wrong: If + had V3, would have V3.

starter.stem: If the government had acted sooner, the crisis ___ been averted.
starter.explanation_short: Type 3: If + had V3, could have + V3.
starter.explanation_long: could have V3 = would have been able to (Type 3 variant).
starter.feedback_wrong: If + had V3, could have V3.
starter.ielts_tip: could have = would have been able to.

starter.stem: If they ___ invested in renewable energy earlier, pollution would have been lower.
starter.explanation_short: Type 3: If + had + V3: had invested.
starter.explanation_long: Type 3: If + had V3, would have V3.
starter.ielts_tip: If + had V3, would/could have V3.

starter.stem: If we had protected forests, many species ___ not have become extinct.
starter.explanation_long: If + had V3, would + not + have + V3.
starter.feedback_correct: 🔥 Type 3 phủ định: would not have become
starter.feedback_wrong: If + had V3, would/would not have V3.
starter.ielts_tip: Type 3 phủ định: would not have V3.

starter.stem: If the warning had been issued earlier, more lives ___ have been saved.
starter.explanation_long: If + had been V3 (passive), would + have been V3.
starter.feedback_correct: ⚡ Type 3 passive: would have been saved
starter.feedback_wrong: If + had been V3, would have been V3.
starter.ielts_tip: Type 3 passive: would have been V3.

starter.stem: If I ___ studied harder, I would have passed the IELTS exam.
starter.explanation_short: Type 3: If + had + V3: had studied.
starter.explanation_long: If + had studied (Past Perfect), would have V3.
starter.feedback_wrong: If + had V3, would have V3.
starter.ielts_tip: Type 3: tiếc nuối → If + had V3.

starter.stem: The floods would not have caused so much damage if the city ___ prepared better.
starter.explanation_long: Type 3: đảo mệnh đề vẫn đúng.
starter.ielts_tip: Type 3: kết quả có thể đặt trước if-clause.

starter.stem: If the company had invested in safety measures, the accident ___ have been prevented.
starter.explanation_long: could have V3 = would have been able to V.
starter.feedback_wrong: If + had V3, could have V3.

starter.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'If the world had act sooner, climate change would have been controlled.'
starter.explanation_short: had + V3: had acted (không had act).
starter.explanation_long: If + had V3: act → acted (regular verb).

starter.stem: If international cooperation ___ been stronger, global poverty would have decreased.
starter.explanation_short: Type 3: If + had + been: had been stronger.
starter.explanation_long: If + had been (Past Perfect), would have V3.
starter.feedback_wrong: If + had been + adj, would have V3.

build_up.stem: If governments had implemented stricter regulations decades ago, the environmental damage ___ have been significantly less severe.
build_up.explanation_short: If + had V3 → would have V3.
build_up.explanation_long: Type 3: If + had implemented, would have been less severe.
build_up.feedback_wrong: If + had V3, would have V3.
build_up.ielts_tip: would have V3 = kết quả giả định quá khứ.

build_up.stem: Many species ___ have survived if their habitats had not been destroyed.
build_up.explanation_short: If + had not been V3 → would have V3.
build_up.explanation_long: Type 3 phủ định: If + had not been destroyed, would have survived.
build_up.feedback_wrong: If + had not V3, would have V3.
build_up.ielts_tip: Type 3 phủ định: had not been V3.

build_up.stem: If the earthquake warning system ___ been in place, the casualties could have been minimized.
build_up.explanation_long: If + had been in place, could have been minimized.
build_up.feedback_wrong: If + had been, could have V3.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'If the organization had received more funding, they will have expanded their operations.'
options: Sai: will have → would have (Type 3 dùng would)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: will have → would have (Type 3 dùng would)
build_up.explanation_short: If + had V3 → would have V3 (không will have).
build_up.explanation_long: Type 3: had received → would have expanded.

build_up.stem: If scientists ___ the dangers of pollution earlier, communities would have been better protected.
build_up.explanation_short: Type 3: If + had V3: had identified.
build_up.explanation_long: If + had identified (Past Perfect), would have been V3.
build_up.feedback_wrong: If + had V3, would have V3.
build_up.ielts_tip: If + had V3 = Past Perfect in if-clause.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'If the leaders invested more in healthcare, the pandemic would not have been so devastating.'
options: Sai: invested → had invested (Type 3 cần Past Perfect)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: invested → had invested (Type 3 cần Past Perfect)
build_up.explanation_short: would have V3 → Type 3 → if-clause cần had V3: had invested.
build_up.explanation_long: 'Would have been' = Type 3 result → if-clause phải dùng had invested (Past Perfect).
build_up.feedback_wrong: If + had V3 (not just V2), would have V3.
build_up.ielts_tip: Type 3: If + had V3. Type 2: If + V2.

build_up.stem: The famine ___ have been prevented if international aid had arrived on time.
build_up.explanation_long: could have V3 = would have been able to V.
build_up.feedback_wrong: If + had V3, could have V3.

build_up.stem: Phát hiện lỗi: 'If we would have known about the risk, we would have evacuated sooner.'
options: Sai: would have known → had known (no would in if-clause)
build_up.correct_answer: Sai: would have known → had known (no would in if-clause)
build_up.explanation_short: If + had V3 (không if + would have V3).
build_up.explanation_long: Type 3: KHÔNG dùng would trong if-clause. 'Would have known' → 'had known'.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🎯 If + had known (không would have known)
build_up.feedback_wrong: If + had V3. KHÔNG if + would have V3.
build_up.ielts_tip: If + had V3 (no would in if-clause).

build_up.stem: If early action ___ been taken on global warming, we would not be facing this crisis today.
build_up.explanation_short: Mixed conditional: If + had been taken, would not be.
build_up.explanation_long: If + had been taken (Type 3 if-clause) + would not be (Type 2 result) = mixed conditional.
build_up.feedback_correct: 🔥 Mixed conditional: had been + would be
build_up.feedback_wrong: Mixed: If + had V3, would + V (present result).
build_up.ielts_tip: Mixed conditional: past condition → present result.

build_up.stem: If the treaty ___ been signed in time, many conflicts would have been avoided.
build_up.explanation_long: If + had been V3 (passive Past Perfect), would have been V3.
build_up.feedback_wrong: If + had been V3, would have V3.
build_up.ielts_tip: Type 3 passive: If + had been V3.

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'If the international community would have responded faster to the crisis, thousands of refugees could have been saved.'
options: would have responded faster to the crisis
challenge.correct_answer: would have responded faster to the crisis
challenge.explanation_short: If + had responded (không would have responded).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'would have responded' → 'had responded' (no would in Type 3 if-clause). Lớp 2: 'could have been saved' = đúng (Type 3 result).
challenge.feedback_wrong: If + had V3. KHÔNG if + would have V3.
challenge.ielts_tip: Type 3: If + had V3, would/could have V3.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (could have been saved) đúng

options: If governments had invested more in disaster preparedness
the impact of natural disasters would have been significantly reduced.
natural disasters would have been reduced.
If governments would have invested more
natural disasters could have been reduced.
challenge.correct_answer: If governments had invested more in disaster preparedness, the impact of natural disasters would have been significantly reduced.
challenge.explanation_short: If + had invested + would have been reduced = Type 3 chuẩn.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'had invested' + 'would have been reduced' = Type 3 nhất quán. Lớp 2: Option B dùng Past (Type 2 if) + Type 3 result. Option C dùng would trong if-clause. Option D thiếu -ed và thiếu have.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 If + had V3, would have been V3 = chuẩn!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Type 3: If + had V3, would have been V3.
challenge.ielts_tip: Type 3 passive: would have been V3.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B trộn Type 2 + Type 3

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'Had the world leaders took decisive action, the environmental crisis could have been averted.'
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Had + took' → 'Had + taken' (V3). take-took-taken. Lớp 2: 'Had + S + V3' = Type 3 inverted (formal). Đúng form: 'Had the leaders taken'.
challenge.ielts_tip: Type 3 inverted: Had + S + V3, would/could have V3.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option D (could have been averted) đúng

challenge.stem: Chọn câu ĐÚNG NHẤT — Mixed Conditional:
options: If the government had invested in education years ago
the literacy rate would be higher today.
If the government invested in education
the literacy rate would be higher today.
If the government had invested in education
the literacy rate would have been higher.
If the government invests in education
the literacy rate will be higher.
challenge.correct_answer: If the government had invested in education years ago, the literacy rate would be higher today.
challenge.explanation_short: Mixed: If + had V3 (past condition), would + V (present result).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'had invested' = past condition (Type 3 if). Lớp 2: 'would be higher today' = present result (Type 2 result). Lớp 3: Mixed conditional = past condition → present consequence.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Mixed conditional: had V3 → would V (present)!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Mixed: If + had V3, would + V (present).
challenge.ielts_tip: Mixed conditional: past condition → present result.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B = pure Type 2, option C = pure Type 3

challenge.stem:
Câu nào ĐÚNG HOÀN TOÀN?
'If the country ___ [A] in technology, it ___ [B] a global leader by now.'
challenge.explanation_short: 'By now' = present → Mixed conditional: had V3 + would V (present).
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'had invested' = past condition. Lớp 2: 'would be' = present result (because 'by now' = present). Mixed conditional: past → present.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Mixed: had invested + would be (by now = present)!
challenge.feedback_wrong: 'By now' = present → would be, not would have been.
challenge.ielts_tip: Mixed conditional: If + had V3, would V (present).
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A (would have become) = pure Type 3, nhưng 'by now' = present

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'If the vaccine had been developed sooner, millions of people would not had died from the pandemic.'
options: If the vaccine had been developed sooner
challenge.explanation_short: would not HAVE died (không had). Modal + have + V3.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'would not had' → 'would not have' (modal + have, not had). Lớp 2: 'had been developed' = đúng (passive Past Perfect in if-clause).
challenge.feedback_wrong: Modal + have + V3. Không modal + had.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A (had been developed) đúng

challenge.stem: Chọn câu body paragraph Task 2 CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: Had governments prioritized renewable energy decades ago
the current climate crisis could have been mitigated.
the climate crisis could have been mitigated.
Had governments would prioritize renewable energy
If governments have prioritized renewable energy
the crisis would have been mitigated.
challenge.correct_answer: Had governments prioritized renewable energy decades ago, the current climate crisis could have been mitigated.
challenge.explanation_short: Type 3 inverted formal: Had + S + V3, could have been V3.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'Had governments prioritized' = Type 3 inverted (formal, academic). Lớp 2: 'could have been mitigated' = đúng. Lớp 3: Option B trộn Past + Type 3 result. Option C dùng would trong inverted.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 Had + S + V3 = Type 3 inverted chuẩn academic!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Had + S + V3, would/could have V3 = formal Type 3.
challenge.ielts_tip: Type 3 inverted: Had + S + V3 (no if).
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option B trộn Type 2 + Type 3

challenge.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'If early education programs had been established, poverty rates might have decrease significantly in developing regions.'
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'might have decrease' → 'might have decreased' (V3). Lớp 2: 'had been established' = đúng (passive Past Perfect).
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option C trông có vẻ sai nhưng 'might have' OK nếu có V3

challenge.stem: Speaking Part 2: 'Kể về một quyết định bạn hối tiếc' — Chọn câu CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: my career would have been different.
If I had studied abroad when I had the chance
my career would have been completely different.
If I would have studied abroad
my career would have been different.
challenge.correct_answer: If I had studied abroad when I had the chance, my career would have been completely different.
challenge.explanation_short: Type 3: If + had studied + would have been = regret chuẩn.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: 'had studied' + 'would have been' = Type 3 chuẩn. Lớp 2: 'when I had the chance' = thêm chi tiết, tự nhiên. Lớp 3: Option A = Type 2 if + Type 3 result. Option C = would in if-clause.
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 If + had V3, would have V3 = regret chuẩn!
challenge.feedback_wrong: Type 3: If + had V3, would have V3.
challenge.distractor_note: near-correct: option A trộn Type 2 + Type 3

challenge.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'If world leaders [A] would have addressed poverty earlier, millions of children [B] will have received education, and global inequality [C] could have been reduce.'
challenge.explanation_short: [A] would have addressed → had addressed. [B] will have → would have. [C] reduce → reduced.
challenge.explanation_long: Lớp 1: [A] 'would have addressed' → 'had addressed' (no would in if-clause). Lớp 2: [B] 'will have received' → 'would have received' (Type 3: would, not will). Lớp 3: [C] 'been reduce' → 'been reduced' (V3).
challenge.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] had addressed | [B] would have received | [C] been reduced!
challenge.feedback_wrong: [A] no would in if. [B] would (not will). [C] been + V3.
challenge.ielts_tip: Type 3: If + had V3, would/could have V3.

items.correct_answer: Had governments prioritized renewable energy decades ago, the current climate crisis could have been mitigated.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 Had + S + V3 = Type 3 inverted chuẩn academic!
items.feedback_wrong: Had + S + V3, would/could have V3 = formal Type 3.
items.explanation_short: Type 3 inverted formal: Had + S + V3, could have been V3.
items.ielts_tip: Type 3 inverted: Had + S + V3 (no if).

items.stem:
Câu sau có lỗi ở phrase nào?
'If early education programs had been established, poverty rates might have decrease significantly in developing regions.'
items.feedback_wrong: Modal + have + V3. decrease → decreased.
items.explanation_short: might have + V3: decreased (không decrease).
items.ielts_tip: might/could/would + have + V3.

items.stem: Speaking Part 2: 'Kể về một quyết định bạn hối tiếc' — Chọn câu CHUẨN NHẤT:
options: my career would have been different.
If I had studied abroad when I had the chance
my career would have been completely different.
If I would have studied abroad
my career would have been different.
items.correct_answer: If I had studied abroad when I had the chance, my career would have been completely different.
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 If + had V3, would have V3 = regret chuẩn!
items.feedback_wrong: Type 3: If + had V3, would have V3.
items.explanation_short: Type 3: If + had studied + would have been = regret chuẩn.
items.ielts_tip: Speaking Part 2: Type 3 cho regret/wish.

items.stem:
🏆 BOSS ROUND — Đoạn Task 2 có BAO NHIÊU phrase chứa lỗi?
'If world leaders [A] would have addressed poverty earlier, millions of children [B] will have received education, and global inequality [C] could have been reduce.'
items.feedback_correct: 🏆 BOSS CLEARED! [A] had addressed | [B] would have received | [C] been reduced!
items.feedback_wrong: [A] no would in if. [B] would (not will). [C] been + V3.
items.explanation_short: [A] would have addressed → had addressed. [B] will have → would have. [C] reduce → reduced.
items.ielts_tip: Type 3: If + had V3, would/could have V3.
